rules: Event Inspection contract is provider-neutral and read-only
single-selected-Tenant scope and Event-tenant equality are mandatory
telemetry-event.read is evaluated server-side before any Event projection
raw and rendered decisions are independent; raw denial exposes neither raw payload nor raw-derived sensitive values
source, normalized, parser and enrichment provenance remain distinguishable
PivotDraft is dialect-neutral and preserves tenant/environment/Event/field/value/time/source/return origin
Case-link, Artifact proposal and Evidence-candidate mutations remain excluded while OPEN-013/OPEN-014 are unresolved
no parser engine, entity-resolution engine, storage engine, provider or final query dialect is selected
